export.title: Export the result
export.description: The file is written straight to disk, whatever the number of rows.
export.live.paused: This result is stopped at its limit of {count} rows. The export follows the query to the end and writes every row; the grid keeps its {count} rows.
export.live.streaming: The query is still running: the export writes every row it returns.

export.csv.nullHint: Empty by default; empty strings are then written as "" to stay distinct.
export.csv.bomHint: Excel needs it to read accented characters.
export.json.numbersHint: Integers beyond 2^53 and long decimals stay strings, so no digit is lost.

export.table.description: Every row of the table, in the tab's sort order, is read from the database and written straight to disk.
export.table.filtered: Only the rows matching the tab's filter are exported.
export.table.pending: Changes not applied yet are not in the file: it holds the rows as stored in the database.

preferences.section.editor.desc: How the SQL editor behaves and when yadbe asks before running.
preferences.section.results.desc: Result limits, table pages and how values are shown.

preferences.setting.theme.hint: Graphite is the dark theme, Paper the light one; System follows the OS.
preferences.setting.density.hint: Compact shrinks the height of rows in lists and grids.
preferences.setting.uiFontSize.hint: Base size of the interface text, from 11 to 18 px (13 by default).
preferences.setting.editorFontFamily.hin: A font installed on this computer; empty uses the bundled JetBrains Mono.
preferences.setting.gridFontFamily.hint: A font installed on this computer; empty uses the bundled JetBrains Mono.
preferences.setting.completeAsYouType.hi: Suggests completions while you type. Turn off to get them only on Ctrl+Space.
preferences.setting.tabSize.hint: Width of a tab, and of an indent when spaces are used.
preferences.setting.indentWithSpaces.hin: Indents with spaces. Turn off and the Tab key inserts a tab character.
preferences.setting.lineWrapping.hint: Wraps long lines. Turn off to scroll them sideways.
preferences.setting.lineNumbers.hint: Shows the line numbers in the margin.
preferences.setting.highlightStatement.h: Tints the statement under the cursor, the one Ctrl+Shift+Enter runs.
preferences.setting.confirmDangerous.hin: Ask before UPDATE or DELETE without WHERE, TRUNCATE and DROP. Always on for connections tagged prod: it cannot be turned off there.
preferences.setting.resultMaxRows.hint: A result pauses after this many rows; you can resume it. From 1 000 to 10 000 000.
preferences.setting.resultMaxMb.hint: A result also pauses when it holds this much data. From 16 to 2 048 MB.
preferences.setting.defaultPageSize.hint: Page size when you open a table to browse it.
preferences.setting.nullText.hint: What the grid shows for a NULL. Copies and exports still write NULL as the database has it.
preferences.setting.nullStyle.hint: Muted italic tells a NULL from the text “NULL” at a glance.
preferences.setting.copyHeaders.hint: The “Copy as” formats of the grid start with the column names.
preferences.setting.previewBeforeApply.h: Shows the SQL of edited rows before it runs. On production connections the preview is always shown.
preferences.setting.displayFormats.hint: Values are shown as the database sends them (ISO 8601, no grouping): nothing is lost or rounded. Other formats are not available yet.
preferences.setting.historyEnabled.hint: Records every statement you run. Turn off to keep nothing. A connection can also opt out in its own settings.
preferences.setting.historyMaxEntries.hi: The oldest entries go first. From 100 to 1 000 000.
preferences.setting.historyMaxAgeDays.hi: Entries older than this go. From 1 to 3 650 days.
preferences.setting.clearHistory.hint: Delete all of it, one connection’s, or a period’s, after a confirmation.
preferences.setting.connectTimeoutSecs.h: For connections that do not set their own. From 1 to 600 seconds.
preferences.setting.tlsRule.hint: Connections to remote hosts verify the certificate and the host name (verify-full) by default; only local hosts start in “prefer”. Set per connection.
preferences.setting.keychain.hint: Remembered passwords go to the OS keychain. When it is not available, they are kept for the session only.
preferences.setting.version.hint: The version of yadbe you are running.
preferences.setting.license.hint: yadbe is free software, under the GNU General Public License.
